INSERT INTO media (
                uploaded_at, media_id, file_path, user_id, 
                content_type, file_hash, file_size, file_ext, original_file_name,
                latitude, longitude, date_taken, metadata
            ) 
            VALUES (unixepoch(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
